title: Hub project — public view
description: The public, no-wallet-needed view of one Hub project: GET /api/hub/<projectId> returns { ok, project: <this> }. Built by lib/hub/public.js projectView(), which WHITELISTS every field — nothing on a comp's or a batch's private record (a payout token, a Telegram chat id, a board message id) can reach this shape, because it is never read from the source record at all. `programs[]` is every program the project has run — buy competitions, Buy Special draws, the CUNA giveaway, and its lock-to-earn ledger — newest first. Each program's own shape depends on its `kind`; this schema pins the fields common to all four kinds (compView/drawView/giveawayView/stakeView in lib/hub/public.js) and leaves the rest open, since that union is not a single stable shape.

$schema.description: present when the serving route stamps it — points back at this file's served URL.

id.description: the project id ("clkn", "cuna", "rose", or a Hub-onboarded project's slug).

symbol.description: ticker shown next to amounts when a program does not carry its own.

decimals.description: decimals of the locked mint, read from chain at project approval — null if the project record does not carry one.

rewardMint.description: the mint a holder is actually paid in for the lock-to-earn program. Equal to `mint` unless the project pays a different asset (design §2 "one immutable reward asset per project").

rewardDecimals.description: decimals of `rewardMint`; every amount inside a `lock-to-earn` program entry in `programs[]` is formatted with THIS, never `decimals` (P1-036 — a project paying a different asset was once shown with the locked token's decimals).

generatedAt.description: ms epoch this view was assembled — not a field on any stored record, so re-fetching always advances it.

programs.description: one entry per program this project has run, sorted newest-start first. `kind` is the discriminant; see lib/hub/public.js for the full per-kind shape (compView → "buy-comp", drawView → "buy-special-draw", giveawayView → "giveaway", stakeView → "lock-to-earn").

kind.description: which program view built this entry — decides which of the additional, unpinned fields to expect.

id.description: the program's own id (a comp id, a draw id, "giveaway-<round>", or "lock-to-earn").

status.description: free-text lifecycle state, meaningful per kind (e.g. a comp: live/verified/closed; lock-to-earn: accruing/not-started).

totals.description: per-kind totals — winners/paid/settled/submitted counts and sealed/paid amounts. Never includes the word "owed" next to an address: an unsent or unreceipted amount is reported as "no receipt on file", never as owed (owner, 2026-09-16).
project-wide rollup across every entry in `programs[]`.

receipts.description: payout rows, across every program, that carry a transaction signature — the only rows publicly shown as paid.

paidRows.description: every payout row across every program, signed or not.

dryRun.description: true for a labelled dry run (a fixture, or a project like POKEAHOE seeded before terms and a funding wallet exist): nothing accrues or pays, it cannot be armed, and it is excluded from every count and feed. Absent or false for a live project.

brand.description: project-provided branding, validated by lib/hub/brand.js at approval: a repo-local logo path only (never a URL), hex accents, a short plain-text tagline, and reviewed HTTPS socials rendered with a "project-provided, not an endorsement" label. null when the project set none.

socials.description: x.com / t.me / the project's own https site only.
